description: LegitFit connects ChatGPT to your LegitFit account so you can ask questions about your fitness business in plain language. Check revenue, net volume and monthly recurring revenue, look up payments and spot failed ones, review bookings, sessions and attendance, find clients, and see how your memberships and packages are performing. Results are scoped to the LegitFit account you sign in with, and you can switch between locations you manage.

defaultPrompt: Give me a business snapshot for the last 30 days
